records.source: http://www.dspace.cam.ac.uk/handle/1810/241564. Whitehorn Paiwan collection, record 10 side a of tape: Christian songs to Aboriginal melodies, sung in the Amis language. The song titles are: 1) He Rose; 2) He Died For Me. He Opened the Way. The Lord's People; 3) The Crown of Thorns; 4) Tell the Nations; 5) Following the Lord; 6) Praise the Trinity. Recorded in 1950s.
